report_identity.report_title: China Electronics Huada Technology Company Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group designs and sells integrated circuit chips, with nearly all revenue from Mainland China.

segments.name: Integrated circuit products and services
segments.business_substance: Sale of integrated circuit chips and provision of related services
segments.source: Annual report 2023, Note 5 revenue and segment information, p.110

business_overview.revenue_model: Mostly sale of goods, revenue recognized when control of goods transfers to customers.
business_notes: The board considers operations to be a single segment.
Two external customers each contributed more than 10% of revenue in 2023.
Nearly 100% of revenue and over 90% of non-current assets are in Mainland China.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow broadly supports reported profit, but working-capital movements are volatile and 2023 included a large inventory provision; use the three-year median parent net profit as pre-haircut distributable profit and apply a cash-profit haircut.

evidence.value: Design and sale of integrated circuit chips

evidence.source: Annual report 2023, general information and financial statements, pp.59-66

evidence.value: Nearly 100% revenue from Mainland China and over 90% non-current assets in Mainland China
evidence.source: Annual report 2023, Note 5 revenue and segment information, p.110

gaps: The annual report does not split cash and deposits by listed-company parent versus operating subsidiaries.
The annual report does not disclose whether each time deposit over 3 months matures within 3-12 months or after 1 year by institution type.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed; owner-earnback analysis uses recent annual purchase of PPE and intangibles as a conservative reference.
Working-capital reinvestment is volatile and cannot be converted into a stable annual reinvestment amount from the available three-year data.
